Policy.name: {=policy_iqta_name}Iqta and Jebelu System
Policy.description: {=policy_iqta_desc}Mandates military tenure across all villages. Village tax revenue increases by 20%, party size increases by +30, strengthening local garrisons.

Policy.name: {=policy_gaza_name}Ghazavat and Futuwwa Law
Policy.description: {=policy_gaza_desc}Battle influence gains increase by 30% and army morale by +15. Campaign speed increases when fighting abroad.

Policy.name: {=policy_nizamiyya_name}Nizamiya Universities Charter
Policy.description: {=policy_nizamiyya_desc}Nizamiya academies improve town security and daily prosperity by +1. Steward and Leadership skill XP increases by 25%.

Policy.name: {=policy_ghulam_name}Ghulam Corps Law
Policy.description: {=policy_ghulam_desc}Elite Ghulam regiments are maintained. Cavalry upkeep reduced by 25%, garrison limits increased.

Policy.name: {=policy_ahi_name}Ahi Guild Regulations
Policy.description: {=policy_ahi_desc}Artisan guilds are regulated. Workshop revenues increase by 25%, caravan tax boosts, and townsfolk join sieges as militia.

Policy.name: {=policy_divan_name}Supreme Divan of Justice
Policy.description: {=policy_divan_desc}The Sultan personally hears commoner petitions. Rebellion risk reduced to zero, daily loyalty +2.

Policy.name: {=policy_caravan_name}Caravanserai Security Decree
Policy.description: {=policy_caravan_desc}Caravanserais and guard posts secure all roads. Caravan bandit raid chances eliminated, trade profits +30%.

Policy.name: {=policy_futuwwa_nizam_name}Futuwwa Order
Policy.description: {=policy_futuwwa_nizam_desc}Artisan workshops and guild production profits in towns increase by 30%, strengthening urban security.

Policy.name: {=policy_uc_gazileri_name}Frontier Gazi Organization
Policy.description: {=policy_uc_gazileri_desc}Frontier warriors and seasoned alps are organized across borderlands. Clan and lord party capacity increases by +25 troops.

Policy.name: {=policy_kervansaray_berati_name}Caravanserai Imperial Charter
Policy.description: {=policy_kervansaray_berati_desc}Caravanserais along the Silk Road receive royal charters. Town prosperity increases by +1 every day permanently.
